name: Fabantou
desc:
Fabantou is a Felinor NPC. He is the landlord of [The Three Cheers](location:the_three_cheers).

Formerly in charge of [the Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority)'s mess hall, he left to start a civilian career with The Three Cheers, though he only serves military personnel. He sells the Tankard of Ongo Juice and Fool's Tankard if the player is an Authority Ensign.
additional_info: -   His name originates from an alias used by Monsieur Thénardier in _Les Misérables_. The phrases he says when purchasing drinks are lyrics taken from Master of the House, a song sung by Thénardier.
